title: Fix: MCP tool detail sections 400 with extra_forbidden on properties/filterTestAccounts
answers: MCP analytics tool detail page shows only errors
Extra inputs are not permitted properties filterTestAccounts MCPTool query
tool detail filters don't narrow tables
body:
Symptom: Every section on the MCP analytics tool detail page fails to load; the requests return 400 with "Extra inputs are not permitted [type=extra_forbidden]" on `properties` and `filterTestAccounts`.
Root cause: the frontend spread the dashboard's shared filters into the tool detail query builders, but the query kinds in frontend/src/queries/schema/schema-general.ts (e.g. `MCPToolStatsQuery`) did not declare the fields. The generated pydantic models in posthog/schema.py use extra="forbid", so `QueryRequest` rejects them before any runner runs.
Fix pattern: declare `properties?: MCPAnalyticsPropertyFilter[]` and `filterTestAccounts?: boolean` on each affected query kind, regenerate with `pnpm schema:build`, and apply them in the runner WHERE via `shared_filter_exprs`.
Constraints: TypeScript cannot catch this, because excess property checks skip spread properties. Logic tests that mock `api.query` also miss it. Only a backend schema check or a runner test shows it.
applies: Any MCP analytics query kind that the frontend sends shared dashboard filters to.
says: Tool detail page only shows errors and fails
Extra properties rejected on tool analytics queries
Tool filters don't narrow data in detail view
